title: Multi-core deviation, ICP, symmetry, thickness and tree build with the standard library only
left: Done 2026-11-08: par::map (std threads, item order kept, sums on one thread); tree build splits subtrees over threads with the same node layout for any count; deviation, ICP pairing, symmetry and thickness rays use it. Bit-identical for 1/2/3/5/8/12/13 threads (tests/parallel.rs). 490k vertices vs 980k triangles, 12 threads: 4.6x (ignored speed test, release). Not parallelised on purpose: segmentation (region growing depends on seed order, so threads would change results). Later: parallel statistics sort if it ever shows in a profile.
